pob.text: And he was with her in the house of the LORD, hiding for six years, while Athaliah was reigning over the land.

spob.text: He stayed with her, hiding in the LORD’s temple for six years. During that time, Athaliah ruled the land.

pob.text: In the seventh year Jehoiada sent and took the commanders of hundreds[a], the Carites, and the runners, and brought them to himself in the house of Yahweh. He made a covenant with them and put them under oath in the house of Yahweh[b], and showed them the king’s son.

pob.text: Ahaz was twenty years old when he began to reign[a], and he reigned sixteen years in Jerusalem. He did not do what was right in the eyes of Yahweh his God[b], as David his father had done.

public_domain_references.bsb: Ahaz was twenty years old when he became king, and he reigned in Jerusalem sixteen years. And unlike David his father, he did not do what was right in the eyes of the LORD his God.
public_domain_references.web: Ahaz was twenty years old when he began to reign, and he reigned sixteen years in Jerusalem. He didn’t do that which was right in Yahweh his God’s eyes, like David his father.
public_domain_references.asv: Twenty years old was Ahaz when he began to reign; and he reigned sixteen years in Jerusalem: and he did not that which was right in the eyes of Jehovah his God, like David his father.
public_domain_references.kjv: Twenty years old [was] Ahaz when he began to reign, and reigned sixteen years in Jerusalem, and did not [that which was] right in the sight of the LORD his God, like David his father.
public_domain_references.brenton: Twenty years old was Achaz when he began to reign, and he reigned sixteen years in Jerusalem; and he did not that which was right in the eyes of the Lord his God faithfully, as David his father [had done].

pob.text: He walked in the way of the kings of Israel[a], and even made his son pass through the fire, according to the abominations of the nations whom Yahweh had driven out before the sons of Israel.

spob.text: He followed the way of the kings of Israel. He even made his son pass through the fire,[a] copying the detestable practices of the nations Yahweh had driven out before the sons of Israel.

public_domain_references.bsb: Instead, he walked in the ways of the kings of Israel and even sacrificed his son in the fire, according to the abominations of the nations that the LORD had driven out before the Israelites.
public_domain_references.web: But he walked in the way of the kings of Israel, and even made his son to pass through the fire, according to the abominations of the nations whom Yahweh cast out from before the children of Israel.
public_domain_references.asv: But he walked in the way of the kings of Israel, yea, and made his son to pass through the fire, according to the abominations of the nations, whom Jehovah cast out from before the children of Israel.
public_domain_references.kjv: But he walked in the way of the kings of Israel, yea, and made his son to pass through the fire, according to the abominations of the heathen, whom the LORD cast out from before the children of Israel.
public_domain_references.brenton: And he walked in the way of the kings of Israel, yea, he made his son to pass through the fire, according to the abominations of the heathen whom the Lord cast out from before the children of Israel.

pob.text: He sacrificed and burned incense on the high places[a], on the hills, and under every green tree.

spob.text: He offered sacrifices and burned incense at local worship sites known as high places, on the hills, and under every green tree.[a]

public_domain_references.bsb: And he sacrificed and burned incense on the high places, on the hills, and under every green tree.
public_domain_references.web: He sacrificed and burned incense in the high places, on the hills, and under every green tree.
public_domain_references.asv: And he sacrificed and burnt incense in the high places, and on the hills, and under every green tree.
public_domain_references.kjv: And he sacrificed and burnt incense in the high places, and on the hills, and under every green tree.
public_domain_references.brenton: And he sacrificed and burnt incense on the high places, and upon the hills, and under every shady tree.

pob.text: Then Rezin king of Aram and Pekah son of Remaliah[a], king of Israel, came up to Jerusalem for war, and they besieged Ahaz, but they were not able to fight against him.

spob.text: Then King Rezin of Aram and King Pekah of Israel, son of Remaliah, marched to Jerusalem for war. They laid siege to Ahaz, but they could not fight against him.[a]

public_domain_references.bsb: Then Rezin king of Aram and Pekah son of Remaliah king of Israel came up to wage war against Jerusalem. They besieged Ahaz but could not overcome him.
public_domain_references.web: Then Rezin king of Syria and Pekah son of Remaliah king of Israel came up to Jerusalem to wage war. They besieged Ahaz, but could not overcome him.
public_domain_references.asv: Then Rezin king of Syria and Pekah son of Remaliah king of Israel came up to Jerusalem to war: and they besieged Ahaz, but could not overcome him.
public_domain_references.kjv: ¶ Then Rezin king of Syria and Pekah son of Remaliah king of Israel came up to Jerusalem to war: and they besieged Ahaz, but could not overcome [him].
public_domain_references.brenton: Then went up Raasson king of Syria and Phakee son of Romelias king of Israel against Jerusalem to war, and besieged Achaz, but could not prevail [against him].

pob.text: At that time Rezin king of Aram restored Elath to Aram[a], and drove the Judeans out of Elath[b]; and the Arameans came to Elath and have lived there to this day.

spob.text: At that time King Rezin of Aram took Elath back for Aram. He drove the Judeans out of the city, and the Arameans moved in and have lived there to this day.[a]

public_domain_references.bsb: At that time Rezin king of Aram recovered Elath for Aram, drove out the men of Judah, and sent the Edomites into Elath, where they live to this day.
public_domain_references.web: At that time Rezin king of Syria recovered Elath to Syria, and drove the Jews from Elath; and the Syrians came to Elath, and live there to this day.
public_domain_references.asv: At that time Rezin king of Syria recovered Elath to Syria, and drove the Jews from Elath; and the Syrians came to Elath, and dwelt there, unto this day.
public_domain_references.kjv: At that time Rezin king of Syria recovered Elath to Syria, and drave the Jews from Elath: and the Syrians came to Elath, and dwelt there unto this day.
public_domain_references.brenton: At that time Raasson king of Syria recovered Ælath to Syria, and drove out the Jews from Ælath, and the Idumeans came to Ælath, and dwelt there until this day.

pob.text: So Ahaz sent messengers to Tiglath-pileser king of Assyria[a], saying, “I am your servant and your son. Come up and save me from the hand of the king of Aram and from the hand of the king of Israel[c][b], who are rising up against me.”

spob.text: So Ahaz sent messengers to King Tiglath-pileser of Assyria with this message: “I am your servant and your son.[a] Come and save me from the grip of the king of Aram[b] and the king of Israel, who are rising against me.”

public_domain_references.bsb: So Ahaz sent messengers to Tiglath-pileser king of Assyria, saying, “I am your servant and your son. Come up and save me from the hands of the kings of Aram and Israel, who are rising up against me.”
public_domain_references.web: So Ahaz sent messengers to Tiglath Pileser king of Assyria, saying, “I am your servant and your son. Come up and save me out of the hand of the king of Syria and out of the hand of the king of Israel, who rise up against me.”
public_domain_references.asv: So Ahaz sent messengers to Tiglath-pileser king of Assyria, saying, I am thy servant and thy son: come up, and save me out of the hand of the king of Syria, and out of the hand of the king of Israel, who rise up against me.
public_domain_references.kjv: So Ahaz sent messengers to Tiglath-pileser king of Assyria, saying, I [am] thy servant and thy son: come up, and save me out of the hand of the king of Syria, and out of the hand of the king of Israel, which rise up against me.
public_domain_references.brenton: And Achaz sent messengers to Thalgath-phellasar king of the Assyrians, saying, I am thy servant and thy son: come up, deliver me out of the hand of the king of Syria, and out of the hand of the king of Israel, who are rising up against me.

pob.text: Ahaz took the silver and the gold that was found in the house of Yahweh and in the treasuries of the king’s house[a], and sent it as a bribe to the king of Assyria.

spob.text: Ahaz took the silver and gold available in Yahweh’s temple and in the palace treasuries. He sent it to the king of Assyria as a bribe.[a]

public_domain_references.bsb: Ahaz also took the silver and gold found in the house of the LORD and in the treasuries of the king’s palace, and he sent it as a gift to the king of Assyria.
public_domain_references.web: Ahaz took the silver and gold that was found in Yahweh’s house, and in the treasures of the king’s house, and sent it for a present to the king of Assyria.
public_domain_references.asv: And Ahaz took the silver and gold that was found in the house of Jehovah, and in the treasures of the king’s house, and sent it for a present to the king of Assyria.
public_domain_references.kjv: And Ahaz took the silver and gold that was found in the house of the LORD, and in the treasures of the king’s house, and sent [it for] a present to the king of Assyria.
public_domain_references.brenton: And Achaz took the silver and the gold that was found in the treasures of the house of the Lord, and of the king's house, and sent gifts to the king.

pob.text: So the king of Assyria listened to him[a], and the king of Assyria went up against Damascus and captured it, and he deported its people to Kir[b], and he put Rezin to death.

spob.text: So the king of Assyria responded to Ahaz's appeal. He marched against Damascus, captured the city, deported its people to Kir, and put Rezin to death.

public_domain_references.bsb: So the king of Assyria responded to him, marched up to Damascus, and captured it. He took its people to Kir as captives and put Rezin to death.
public_domain_references.web: The king of Assyria listened to him; and the king of Assyria went up against Damascus and took it, and carried its people captive to Kir, and killed Rezin.
public_domain_references.asv: And the king of Assyria hearkened unto him; and the king of Assyria went up against Damascus, and took it, and carried [the people of] it captive to Kir, and slew Rezin.
public_domain_references.kjv: And the king of Assyria hearkened unto him: for the king of Assyria went up against Damascus, and took it, and carried [the people of] it captive to Kir, and slew Rezin.
public_domain_references.brenton: And the king of the Assyrians hearkened to him: and the king of the Assyrians went up to Damascus and took it, and removed the inhabitants, and slew king Raasson.

pob.text: Then King Ahaz went to meet Tiglath-pileser king of Assyria at Damascus, and he saw the altar that was at Damascus. And King Ahaz sent to Uriah the priest a model of the altar and its pattern, according to all its workmanship.

spob.text: Then King Ahaz traveled to Damascus to meet King Tiglath-pileser of Assyria. There he saw the altar in Damascus. Ahaz sent Uriah the priest a model of the altar and detailed plans for all its construction.

public_domain_references.bsb: Then King Ahaz went to Damascus to meet Tiglath-pileser king of Assyria. On seeing the altar in Damascus, King Ahaz sent Uriah the priest a model of the altar and complete plans for its construction.
public_domain_references.web: King Ahaz went to Damascus to meet Tiglath Pileser king of Assyria, and saw the altar that was at Damascus; and King Ahaz sent to Urijah the priest a drawing of the altar and plans to build it.
public_domain_references.asv: And king Ahaz went to Damascus to meet Tiglath-pileser king of Assyria, and saw the altar that was at Damascus; and king Ahaz sent to Urijah the priest the fashion of the altar, and the pattern of it, according to all the workmanship thereof.
public_domain_references.kjv: ¶ And king Ahaz went to Damascus to meet Tiglath-pileser king of Assyria, and saw an altar that [was] at Damascus: and king Ahaz sent to Urijah the priest the fashion of the altar, and the pattern of it, according to all the workmanship thereof.
public_domain_references.brenton: And king Achaz went to Damascus to meet Thalgath-phellasar king of the Assyrians at Damascus; and he saw an altar at Damascus. And king Achaz sent to Urias the priest the pattern of the altar, and its proportions, and all its workmanship.

pob.text: So Uriah the priest built the altar[a], according to all that King Ahaz had sent from Damascus; thus Uriah the priest did, until King Ahaz came from Damascus.

spob.text: Uriah the priest built the altar exactly according to what King Ahaz had sent from Damascus. He finished it before King Ahaz arrived from Damascus.

public_domain_references.bsb: And Uriah the priest built the altar according to all the instructions King Ahaz had sent from Damascus, and he completed it by the time King Ahaz had returned.
public_domain_references.web: Urijah the priest built an altar. According to all that King Ahaz had sent from Damascus, so Urijah the priest made it for the coming of King Ahaz from Damascus.
public_domain_references.asv: And Urijah the priest built an altar: according to all that king Ahaz had sent from Damascus, so did Urijah the priest make it against the coming of king Ahaz from Damascus.
public_domain_references.kjv: And Urijah the priest built an altar according to all that king Ahaz had sent from Damascus: so Urijah the priest made [it] against king Ahaz came from Damascus.
public_domain_references.brenton: And Urias the priest built the altar, according to all [the directions] which king Achaz sent from Damascus.

pob.text: When the king came from Damascus[a], the king saw the altar; and the king came near to the altar and went up on it.

spob.text: When the king arrived from Damascus, he saw the altar. He approached it and went up onto it.[a]

public_domain_references.bsb: When the king came back from Damascus and saw the altar, he approached it and presented offerings on it.
public_domain_references.web: When the king had come from Damascus, the king saw the altar; and the king came near to the altar, and offered on it.
public_domain_references.asv: And when the king was come from Damascus, the king saw the altar: and the king drew near unto the altar, and offered thereon.
public_domain_references.kjv: And when the king was come from Damascus, the king saw the altar: and the king approached to the altar, and offered thereon.
public_domain_references.brenton: And the king saw the altar, and went up to it,

pob.text: And he burned his burnt offering and his grain offering[a], and he poured out his drink offering, and he threw the blood of the peace offerings that were his against the altar.

spob.text: He burned his burnt offering and grain offering. Then he poured out his drink offering and threw the blood of his peace offerings[a] against the altar.

public_domain_references.bsb: He offered his burnt offering and his grain offering, poured out his drink offering, and sprinkled the blood of his peace offerings on the altar.
public_domain_references.web: He burned his burnt offering and his meal offering, poured his drink offering, and sprinkled the blood of his peace offerings on the altar.
public_domain_references.asv: And he burnt his burnt-offering and his meal-offering, and poured his drink-offering, and sprinkled the blood of his peace-offerings, upon the altar.
public_domain_references.kjv: And he burnt his burnt offering and his meat offering, and poured his drink offering, and sprinkled the blood of his peace offerings, upon the altar.
public_domain_references.brenton: and offered his whole-burnt-offering, and his meat-offering, and his drink-offering, and poured out the blood of his peace-offerings on the brazen altar that was before the Lord.

pob.text: As for the bronze altar that was before Yahweh[a], he brought it from the front of the house, from between the altar and the house of Yahweh[b], and put it on the north side of the altar.

spob.text: He moved the bronze altar[a] that stood before Yahweh away from the front of the temple, where it had stood between the new altar and Yahweh’s temple. He placed the bronze altar on the north side of the new altar.

public_domain_references.bsb: He also took the bronze altar that stood before the LORD from the front of the temple (between the new altar and the house of the LORD) and he put it on the north side of the new altar.
public_domain_references.web: The bronze altar, which was before Yahweh, he brought from the front of the house, from between his altar and Yahweh’s house, and put it on the north side of his altar.
public_domain_references.asv: And the brazen altar, which was before Jehovah, he brought from the forefront of the house, from between his altar and the house of Jehovah, and put it on the north side of his altar.
public_domain_references.kjv: And he brought also the brasen altar, which [was] before the LORD, from the forefront of the house, from between the altar and the house of the LORD, and put it on the north side of the altar.
public_domain_references.brenton: And he brought forward [the one] before the house of the Lord from between the altar and the house of the Lord, and he set it openly by the side of the altar northwards.

pob.text: Then King Ahaz commanded Uriah the priest[a], saying, “On the great altar offer up the morning burnt offering and the evening grain offering, and the king’s burnt offering and his grain offering, and the burnt offering of all the people of the land and their grain offerings and their drink offerings; and throw on it all the blood of the burnt offering and all the blood of the sacrifice. But the bronze altar shall be for me to inquire by.”

spob.text: Then King Ahaz ordered Uriah the priest: “Offer on the great altar the morning burnt offering, the evening grain offering, the king’s burnt offering and grain offering, and the burnt, grain, and drink offerings of all the people of the land. Throw on it all the blood from the burnt offerings and sacrifices. But reserve the bronze altar for me to inquire by.[a]”

public_domain_references.bsb: Then King Ahaz commanded Uriah the priest, “Offer on the great altar the morning burnt offering, the evening grain offering, and the king’s burnt offering and grain offering, as well as the burnt offerings, grain offerings, and drink offerings of all the people of the land. Sprinkle on the altar all the blood of the burnt offerings and sacrifices. But I will use the bronze altar to seek guidance.”
public_domain_references.web: King Ahaz commanded Urijah the priest, saying, “On the great altar burn the morning burnt offering, the evening meal offering, the king’s burnt offering and his meal offering, with the burnt offering of all the people of the land, their meal offering, and their drink offerings; and sprinkle on it all the blood of the burnt offering, and all the blood of the sacrifice; but the bronze altar will be for me to inquire by.”
public_domain_references.asv: And king Ahaz commanded Urijah the priest, saying, Upon the great altar burn the morning burnt-offering, and the evening meal-offering, and the king’s burnt-offering, and his meal-offering, with the burnt-offering of all the people of the land, and their meal-offering, and their drink-offerings; and sprinkle upon it all the blood of the burnt-offering, and all the blood of the sacrifice: but the brazen altar shall be for me to inquire by.
public_domain_references.kjv: And king Ahaz commanded Urijah the priest, saying, Upon the great altar burn the morning burnt offering, and the evening meat offering, and the king’s burnt sacrifice, and his meat offering, with the burnt offering of all the people of the land, and their meat offering, and their drink offerings; and sprinkle upon it all the blood of the burnt offering, and all the blood of the sacrifice: and the brasen altar shall be for me to enquire [by].
public_domain_references.brenton: And king Achaz charged Urias the priest, saying, Offer upon the great altar the whole-burnt-offering in the morning and the meat-offering in the evening, and the whole-burnt-offering of the king, and his meat-offering, and the whole-burnt-offering of all the people, and their meat-offering, and their drink-offering; and thou shalt pour all the blood of the whole-burnt-offering, and all the blood of [any other] sacrifice upon it: and the brazen altar shall be for me in the morning.

pob.text: So Uriah the priest did according to all that King Ahaz had commanded.

spob.text: So Uriah the priest did everything King Ahaz had commanded him to do.

public_domain_references.bsb: So Uriah the priest did just as King Ahaz had commanded.
public_domain_references.web: Urijah the priest did so, according to all that King Ahaz commanded.
public_domain_references.asv: Thus did Urijah the priest, according to all that king Ahaz commanded.
public_domain_references.kjv: Thus did Urijah the priest, according to all that king Ahaz commanded.
public_domain_references.brenton: And Urias the priest did according to all that king Achaz commanded him.

pob.text: Then King Ahaz cut off the frames of the stands and removed the basin from them[c][b][a], and he took down the Sea from upon the bronze oxen that were under it and put it on a stone pavement.

spob.text: Then King Ahaz cut away the frames from the temple stands and removed the basin that rested on them. He also took the Sea[a] down from the bronze oxen beneath it and placed it on a stone pavement.

public_domain_references.bsb: King Ahaz also cut off the frames of the movable stands and removed the bronze basin from each of them. He took down the Sea from the bronze oxen that were under it and put it on a stone base.
public_domain_references.web: King Ahaz cut off the panels of the bases, and removed the basin from off them, and took down the sea from off the bronze oxen that were under it, and put it on a pavement of stone.
public_domain_references.asv: And king Ahaz cut off the panels of the bases, and removed the laver from off them, and took down the sea from off the brazen oxen that were under it, and put it upon a pavement of stone.
public_domain_references.kjv: ¶ And king Ahaz cut off the borders of the bases, and removed the laver from off them; and took down the sea from off the brasen oxen that [were] under it, and put it upon a pavement of stones.
public_domain_references.brenton: And king Achaz cut off the borders of the bases, and removed the laver from off them, and took down the sea from the brazen oxen that were under it, and set it upon a base of stone.

pob.text: And the covered way for the Sabbath that they had built in the house[a], and the outer entrance of the king[d][c][b], he turned away from the house of Yahweh because of the king of Assyria.

spob.text: He removed from Yahweh’s temple the covered structure for the Sabbath that they had built there,[a] along with the king’s outer entrance.[b] He did this because of the king of Assyria.[c]

public_domain_references.bsb: And on account of the king of Assyria, he removed the Sabbath canopy they had built in the temple and closed the royal entryway outside the house of the LORD.
public_domain_references.web: He removed the covered way for the Sabbath that they had built in the house, and the king’s outer entrance to Yahweh’s house, because of the king of Assyria.
public_domain_references.asv: And the covered way for the sabbath that they had built in the house, and the king’s entry without, turned he unto the house of Jehovah, because of the king of Assyria.
public_domain_references.kjv: And the covert for the sabbath that they had built in the house, and the king’s entry without, turned he from the house of the LORD for the king of Assyria.
public_domain_references.brenton: And he made a base for the throne in the house of the Lord, and he turned the king's entrance without in the house of the Lord because of the king of the Assyrians.

pob.text: The rest of the acts of Ahaz[a], which he did, are they not written in the Book of the Chronicles of the Kings of Judah?

spob.text: The rest of what Ahaz did is written in the Book of the Chronicles of the Kings of Judah, is it not?[a]

public_domain_references.bsb: As for the rest of the acts of Ahaz, along with his accomplishments, are they not written in the Book of the Chronicles of the Kings of Judah?
public_domain_references.web: Now the rest of the acts of Ahaz which he did, aren’t they written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?
public_domain_references.asv: Now the rest of the acts of Ahaz which he did, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?
public_domain_references.kjv: ¶ Now the rest of the acts of Ahaz which he did, [are] they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?
public_domain_references.brenton: And the rest of the acts of Achaz, even all that he did, [are] not these written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Juda?

pob.text: And Ahaz slept with his fathers and was buried with his fathers in the city of David[a], and Hezekiah his son reigned in his place.

spob.text: Ahaz died and joined his ancestors.[a] He was buried with his ancestors in the city of David. Then his son Hezekiah became king in his place.

public_domain_references.bsb: And Ahaz rested with his fathers and was buried with them in the City of David, and his son Hezekiah reigned in his place.
public_domain_references.web: Ahaz slept with his fathers, and was buried with his fathers in David’s city; and Hezekiah his son reigned in his place.
public_domain_references.asv: And Ahaz slept with his fathers, and was buried with his fathers in the city of David: and Hezekiah his son reigned in his stead.
public_domain_references.kjv: And Ahaz slept with his fathers, and was buried with his fathers in the city of David: and Hezekiah his son reigned in his stead.
public_domain_references.brenton: And Achaz slept with his fathers, and was buried in the city of David: and Ezekias his son reigned in his stead.

pob.text: In the twelfth year of Ahaz king of Judah, Hoshea son of Elah began to reign in Samaria over Israel, and he reigned nine years.

spob.text: In the twelfth year of King Ahaz of Judah, Hoshea son of Elah began to reign over Israel in Samaria. He reigned for nine years.

public_domain_references.bsb: In the twelfth year of the reign of Ahaz over Judah, Hoshea son of Elah became king of Israel, and he reigned in Samaria nine years.
public_domain_references.web: In the twelfth year of Ahaz king of Judah, Hoshea the son of Elah began to reign in Samaria over Israel for nine years.
public_domain_references.asv: In the twelfth year of Ahaz king of Judah began Hoshea the son of Elah to reign in Samaria over Israel, [and reigned] nine years.
public_domain_references.kjv: In the twelfth year of Ahaz king of Judah began Hoshea the son of Elah to reign in Samaria over Israel nine years.
public_domain_references.brenton: In the twelfth year of Achaz king of Juda began Osee the son of Ela to reign in Samaria over Israel nine years.

pob.text: He did what was evil in the eyes of Yahweh[a], yet not like the kings of Israel who were before him.

spob.text: He did what was evil in Yahweh’s eyes. However, he did not act like the kings of Israel who ruled before him.

public_domain_references.bsb: And he did evil in the sight of the LORD, but not like the kings of Israel who preceded him.
public_domain_references.web: He did that which was evil in Yahweh’s sight, yet not as the kings of Israel who were before him.
public_domain_references.asv: And he did that which was evil in the sight of Jehovah, yet not as the kings of Israel that were before him.
public_domain_references.kjv: And he did [that which was] evil in the sight of the LORD, but not as the kings of Israel that were before him.
public_domain_references.brenton: And he did evil in the eyes of the Lord, only not as the kings of Israel that were before him.

pob.text: Shalmaneser king of Assyria came up against him[a], and Hoshea became his servant and paid him tribute.

spob.text: Shalmaneser king of Assyria marched against Hoshea. Hoshea became subject to him and paid him tribute.

public_domain_references.bsb: Shalmaneser king of Assyria attacked him, and Hoshea became his vassal and paid him tribute.
public_domain_references.web: Shalmaneser king of Assyria came up against him; and Hoshea became his servant, and brought him tribute.
public_domain_references.asv: Against him came up Shalmaneser king of Assyria; and Hoshea became his servant, and brought him tribute.
public_domain_references.kjv: ¶ Against him came up Shalmaneser king of Assyria; and Hoshea became his servant, and gave him presents.
public_domain_references.brenton: Against him came up Salamanassar king of the Assyrians; and Osee became his servant, and rendered him tribute.

pob.text: Then the king of Assyria discovered a conspiracy in Hoshea[a], because he had sent messengers to So king of Egypt and had not sent up tribute to the king of Assyria, as year by year[d][c][b]. So the king of Assyria confined him and bound him in prison.

spob.text: The king of Assyria discovered that Hoshea was involved in a conspiracy. He discovered this because Hoshea had sent messengers to the Egyptian king named So[a] and had stopped sending his yearly tribute to Assyria. So the Assyrian king detained Hoshea, then bound him and put him in prison.

public_domain_references.bsb: But the king of Assyria discovered that Hoshea had conspired to send envoys to King So of Egypt, and that he had not paid tribute to the king of Assyria as in previous years. Therefore the king of Assyria arrested Hoshea and put him in prison.
public_domain_references.web: The king of Assyria discovered a conspiracy in Hoshea; for he had sent messengers to So king of Egypt, and offered no tribute to the king of Assyria, as he had done year by year. Therefore the king of Assyria seized him, and bound him in prison.

public_domain_references.kjv: Behold therefore, I will gather thee unto thy fathers, and thou shalt be gathered into thy grave in peace; and thine eyes shall not see all the evil which I will bring upon this place. And they brought the king word again.
public_domain_references.brenton: It shall not be so [therefore]: behold, I [will] add thee to thy fathers, and thou shalt be gathered to thy tomb in peace, and thine eyes shall not see [any] among all the evils which I bring upon this place.

pob.text: Then the king sent[a], and all the elders of Judah and Jerusalem were gathered to him.

spob.text: Then the king sent for all the elders of Judah and Jerusalem, and they gathered to him.[a]

public_domain_references.bsb: Then the king summoned all the elders of Judah and Jerusalem.
public_domain_references.web: The king sent, and they gathered to him all the elders of Judah and of Jerusalem.
public_domain_references.asv: And the king sent, and they gathered unto him all the elders of Judah and of Jerusalem.
public_domain_references.kjv: And the king sent, and they gathered unto him all the elders of Judah and of Jerusalem.
public_domain_references.brenton: So they reported the word to the king: and the king sent and gathered all the elders of Juda and Jerusalem to himself.

pob.text: Then the king went up to the house of Yahweh[a], and with him all the men of Judah and all the inhabitants of Jerusalem, and the priests and the prophets, all the people from small to great[c][b]; and he read in their hearing all the words of the Book of the Covenant that had been found in the house of Yahweh.

spob.text: Then the king went up to the temple of Yahweh.[a] All the men of Judah went with him, along with everyone who lived in Jerusalem, the priests, the prophets, and all the people, from the least to the greatest. The king read aloud to them every word of the Book of the Covenant that had been found in Yahweh’s temple.

public_domain_references.bsb: And he went up to the house of the LORD with all the people of Judah and Jerusalem, as well as the priests and the prophets—all the people small and great—and in their hearing he read all the words of the Book of the Covenant that had been found in the house of the LORD.
public_domain_references.web: The king went up to Yahweh’s house, and all the men of Judah and all the inhabitants of Jerusalem with him—with the priests, the prophets, and all the people, both small and great; and he read in their hearing all the words of the book of the covenant which was found in Yahweh’s house.
public_domain_references.asv: And the king went up to the house of Jehovah, and all the men of Judah and all the inhabitants of Jerusalem with him, and the priests, and the prophets, and all the people, both small and great: and he read in their ears all the words of the book of the covenant which was found in the house of Jehovah.
public_domain_references.kjv: And the king went up into the house of the LORD, and all the men of Judah and all the inhabitants of Jerusalem with him, and the priests, and the prophets, and all the people, both small and great: and he read in their ears all the words of the book of the covenant which was found in the house of the LORD.
public_domain_references.brenton: And the king went up to the house of the Lord, and every man of Juda and all who dwelt in Jerusalem with him, and the priests, and the prophets, and all the people small and great; and he read in their ears all the words of the book of the covenant that was found in the house of the Lord.

pob.text: Then the king stood by the pillar and made the covenant before Yahweh: to walk after Yahweh[a], and to keep his commandments, his testimonies, and his statutes with all his heart and with all his soul, to carry out the words of this covenant that were written in this book[b]. And all the people entered into the covenant.

spob.text: Then the king stood beside the pillar and made the covenant before Yahweh. He committed himself to follow Yahweh, to keep Yahweh’s commands, covenant requirements, and laws with all his heart and soul, and to carry out the words of this covenant written in this book.[a] All the people entered into the covenant.[b]

public_domain_references.bsb: So the king stood by the pillar and made a covenant before the LORD to follow the LORD and to keep His commandments, decrees, and statutes with all his heart and all his soul, and to carry out the words of this covenant that were written in this book. And all the people entered into the covenant.
public_domain_references.web: The king stood by the pillar and made a covenant before Yahweh to walk after Yahweh and to keep his commandments, his testimonies, and his statutes with all his heart and all his soul, to confirm the words of this covenant that were written in this book; and all the people agreed to the covenant.
public_domain_references.asv: And the king stood by the pillar, and made a covenant before Jehovah, to walk after Jehovah, and to keep his commandments, and his testimonies, and his statutes, with all [his] heart, and all [his] soul, to confirm the words of this covenant that were written in this book: and all the people stood to the covenant.
public_domain_references.kjv: ¶ And the king stood by a pillar, and made a covenant before the LORD, to walk after the LORD, and to keep his commandments and his testimonies and his statutes with all [their] heart and all [their] soul, to perform the words of this covenant that were written in this book. And all the people stood to the covenant.
public_domain_references.brenton: And the king stood by a pillar, and made a covenant before the Lord, to walk after the Lord, to keep his commandments and his testimonies and his ordinances with all the heart and with all the soul, to confirm the words of this covenant; [even] the things written in this book. And all the people stood to the covenant.

pob.text: Then the king commanded Hilkiah the high priest[a], the priests of the second order, and the keepers of the threshold to bring out from the temple of Yahweh all the vessels made for Baal, for Asherah, and for all the host of heaven. He burned them outside Jerusalem in the fields of the Kidron, and carried their dust to Bethel.

spob.text: Then the king ordered Hilkiah the high priest, the lower-ranking priests, and the temple doorkeepers to remove from Yahweh’s temple every object made for Baal, Asherah,[a] and all the host of heaven. He burned these objects in the fields of the Kidron Valley outside Jerusalem, then carried their dust to Bethel.

public_domain_references.bsb: Then the king commanded Hilkiah the high priest, the priests second in rank, and the doorkeepers to remove from the temple of the LORD all the articles made for Baal, Asherah, and all the host of heaven. And he burned them outside Jerusalem in the fields of Kidron and carried their ashes to Bethel.
public_domain_references.web: The king commanded Hilkiah the high priest, and the priests of the second order, and the keepers of the threshold, to bring out of Yahweh’s temple all the vessels that were made for Baal, for the Asherah, and for all the army of the sky; and he burned them outside of Jerusalem in the fields of the Kidron, and carried their ashes to Bethel.
public_domain_references.asv: And the king commanded Hilkiah the high priest, and the priests of the second order, and the keepers of the threshold, to bring forth out of the temple of Jehovah all the vessels that were made for Baal, and for the Asherah, and for all the host of heaven, and he burned them without Jerusalem in the fields of the Kidron, and carried the ashes of them unto Beth-el.
public_domain_references.kjv: And the king commanded Hilkiah the high priest, and the priests of the second order, and the keepers of the door, to bring forth out of the temple of the LORD all the vessels that were made for Baal, and for the grove, and for all the host of heaven: and he burned them without Jerusalem in the fields of Kidron, and carried the ashes of them unto Beth-el.
public_domain_references.brenton: And the king commanded Chelcias the high priest, and the priests of the second order, and them that kept the door, to bring out of the temple of the Lord all the vessels that were made for Baal, and for the grove, and all the host of heaven, and he burned them without Jerusalem in the fields of Kedron, and took the ashes of them to Bæthel.

pob.text: And he put an end to the priests whom the kings of Judah had appointed to burn incense at the high places in the cities of Judah and around Jerusalem[a], and also those who burned incense to Baal, to the sun, to the moon, to the constellations[c][b], and to all the host of the heavens.

spob.text: He put an end to the idolatrous priests whom the kings of Judah had appointed to burn incense at the local worship sites called high places, in the cities of Judah and around Jerusalem. He also put an end to those who burned incense to Baal, the sun, the moon, the constellations,[a] and the whole array of heavenly bodies.

public_domain_references.bsb: Josiah also did away with the idolatrous priests ordained by the kings of Judah to burn incense on the high places of the cities of Judah and in the places all around Jerusalem—those who had burned incense to Baal, to the sun and moon, to the constellations, and to all the host of heaven.
public_domain_references.web: He got rid of the idolatrous priests whom the kings of Judah had ordained to burn incense in the high places in the cities of Judah and in the places around Jerusalem; those also who burned incense to Baal, to the sun, to the moon, to the planets, and to all the army of the sky.
public_domain_references.asv: And he put down the idolatrous priests, whom the kings of Judah had ordained to burn incense in the high places in the cities of Judah, and in the places round about Jerusalem; them also that burned incense unto Baal, to the sun, and to the moon, and to the planets, and to all the host of heaven.
public_domain_references.kjv: And he put down the idolatrous priests, whom the kings of Judah had ordained to burn incense in the high places in the cities of Judah, and in the places round about Jerusalem; them also that burned incense unto Baal, to the sun, and to the moon, and to the planets, and to all the host of heaven.
public_domain_references.brenton: And he burned the idolatrous priests, whom the kings of Juda [had] appointed, (and they burned incense in the high places and in the cities of Juda, and the places round about Jerusalem); and them that burned incense to Baal, and to the sun, and to the moon, and to Mazuroth, and to all the host of heaven.

pob.text: He brought the Asherah out from the house of Yahweh[a], outside Jerusalem, to the Kidron Valley, and burned it in the Kidron Valley, and beat it to dust, and threw its dust on the graves of the common people.

spob.text: He took the Asherah[a] out of Yahweh’s temple and carried it beyond Jerusalem to the Kidron Valley. There he burned it, crushed it into dust, and threw the dust onto the graves of ordinary people.

public_domain_references.bsb: He brought the Asherah pole from the house of the LORD to the Kidron Valley outside Jerusalem, and there he burned it, ground it to powder, and threw its dust on the graves of the common people.
public_domain_references.web: He brought out the Asherah from Yahweh’s house, outside of Jerusalem, to the brook Kidron, and burned it at the brook Kidron, and beat it to dust, and cast its dust on the graves of the common people.
public_domain_references.asv: And he brought out the Asherah from the house of Jehovah, without Jerusalem, unto the brook Kidron, and burned it at the brook Kidron, and beat it to dust, and cast the dust thereof upon the graves of the common people.
public_domain_references.kjv: And he brought out the grove from the house of the LORD, without Jerusalem, unto the brook Kidron, and burned it at the brook Kidron, and stamped [it] small to powder, and cast the powder thereof upon the graves of the children of the people.
public_domain_references.brenton: And he carried out the grove from the house of the Lord to the brook Kedron, and burned it at the brook Kedron, and reduced it to powder, and cast its powder on the sepulchres of the sons of the people.

pob.text: He tore down the houses of the cult prostitutes that were in the house of Yahweh[c][b][a], where the women were weaving hangings for the Asherah.

spob.text: He tore down the rooms used by the cult prostitutes inside Yahweh’s temple.[a] In those rooms, women wove coverings for the Asherah.[b][c]

public_domain_references.bsb: He also tore down the quarters of the male shrine prostitutes that were in the house of the LORD, where the women had woven tapestries for Asherah.
public_domain_references.web: He broke down the houses of the male shrine prostitutes that were in Yahweh’s house, where the women wove hangings for the Asherah.
public_domain_references.asv: And he brake down the houses of the sodomites, that were in the house of Jehovah, where the women wove hangings for the Asherah.
public_domain_references.kjv: And he brake down the houses of the sodomites, that [were] by the house of the LORD, where the women wove hangings for the grove.
public_domain_references.brenton: And he pulled down the house of the sodomites that were by the house of the Lord, where the women wove tents for the grove.

pob.text: He brought all the priests from the cities of Judah and defiled the high places where the priests had burned incense[a], from Geba to Beer-sheba. He also tore down the high places of the gates that were at the entrance of the gate of Joshua the governor of the city[b], which were on the left of a man at the city gate.

spob.text: He brought in all the priests from the towns of Judah. From Geba to Beer-sheba, he defiled the local worship sites where the priests had burned incense. He also tore down the shrines at the city gates. These were at the entrance to the gate of Joshua, the city governor, on a person's left at the city gate.[a]

public_domain_references.bsb: Then Josiah brought all the priests from the cities of Judah and desecrated the high places, from Geba to Beersheba, where the priests had burned incense. He tore down the high places of the gates at the entrance of the gate of Joshua the governor of the city, which was to the left of the city gate.
public_domain_references.web: He brought all the priests out of the cities of Judah, and defiled the high places where the priests had burned incense, from Geba to Beersheba; and he broke down the high places of the gates that were at the entrance of the gate of Joshua the governor of the city, which were on a man’s left hand at the gate of the city.
public_domain_references.asv: And he brought all the priests out of the cities of Judah, and defiled the high places where the priests had burned incense, from Geba to Beer-sheba; and he brake down the high places of the gates that were at the entrance of the gate of Joshua the governor of the city, which were on a man’s left hand at the gate of the city.
public_domain_references.kjv: And he brought all the priests out of the cities of Judah, and defiled the high places where the priests had burned incense, from Geba to Beer-sheba, and brake down the high places of the gates that [were] in the entering in of the gate of Joshua the governor of the city, which [were] on a man’s left hand at the gate of the city.
public_domain_references.brenton: And he brought up all the priests from the cities of Juda, and defiled the high places where the priests burned incense, from Gæbal even to Bersabee; and he pulled down the house of the gates that was by the door of the gate of Joshua the ruler of the city, on a man's left hand at the gate of the city.

pob.text: However[a], the priests of the high places did not go up to the altar of Yahweh in Jerusalem[c][b], but they ate unleavened bread among their brothers.

spob.text: However, the priests from the local shrines known as high places[a] did not go up to Yahweh’s altar in Jerusalem. Instead, they ate unleavened bread with their fellow priests.[b]

public_domain_references.bsb: Although the priests of the high places did not come up to the altar of the LORD in Jerusalem, they ate unleavened bread with their fellow priests.
public_domain_references.web: Nevertheless the priests of the high places didn’t come up to Yahweh’s altar in Jerusalem, but they ate unleavened bread among their brothers.
public_domain_references.asv: Nevertheless the priests of the high places came not up to the altar of Jehovah in Jerusalem, but they did eat unleavened bread among their brethren.
public_domain_references.kjv: Nevertheless the priests of the high places came not up to the altar of the LORD in Jerusalem, but they did eat of the unleavened bread among their brethren.
public_domain_references.brenton: Only the priests of the high places went not up to the altar of the Lord in Jerusalem, for they only ate leavened bread in the midst of their brethren.

pob.text: And he defiled Topheth[a], which is in the Valley of Ben-hinnom[c][b], so that no man might make his son or his daughter pass through the fire to Molech.

spob.text: He made Topheth, in the Valley of Ben-hinnom, ritually unclean so that it could no longer be used for this practice. He did this to prevent anyone from making a son or daughter pass through the fire to Molech.[a]

public_domain_references.bsb: He also desecrated Topheth in the Valley of Ben-hinnom so that no one could sacrifice his son or daughter in the fire to Molech.
public_domain_references.web: He defiled Topheth, which is in the valley of the children of Hinnom, that no man might make his son or his daughter to pass through the fire to Molech.
public_domain_references.asv: And he defiled Topheth, which is in the valley of the children of Hinnom, that no man might make his son or his daughter to pass through the fire to Molech.
public_domain_references.kjv: And he defiled Topheth, which [is] in the valley of the children of Hinnom, that no man might make his son or his daughter to pass through the fire to Molech.
public_domain_references.brenton: And he defiled Tapheth which is in the valley of the son of Ennom, [constructed] for a man to cause his son or his daughter to pass through fire to Moloch.

pob.text: He removed the horses that the kings of Judah had dedicated to the sun[a], from the entrance of the house of Yahweh to the chamber of Nethan-melech the court official, which was in the precincts[b]; and he burned the chariots of the sun with fire.

spob.text: He removed the horses that the kings of Judah had dedicated to the sun from the entrance to Yahweh’s temple, near the room of Nethan-melech, the court official,[a] in an outer part of the temple grounds.[b] He also set the chariots of the sun on fire.

public_domain_references.bsb: And he removed from the entrance to the house of the LORD the horses that the kings of Judah had dedicated to the sun. They were in the court near the chamber of an official named Nathan-melech. And Josiah burned up the chariots of the sun.
public_domain_references.web: He took away the horses that the kings of Judah had dedicated to the sun, at the entrance of Yahweh’s house, by the room of Nathan Melech the officer who was in the court; and he burned the chariots of the sun with fire.
public_domain_references.asv: And he took away the horses that the kings of Judah had given to the sun, at the entrance of the house of Jehovah, by the chamber of Nathan-melech the chamberlain, which was in the precincts; and he burned the chariots of the sun with fire.
public_domain_references.kjv: And he took away the horses that the kings of Judah had given to the sun, at the entering in of the house of the LORD, by the chamber of Nathan-melech the chamberlain, which [was] in the suburbs, and burned the chariots of the sun with fire.
public_domain_references.brenton: And he burned the horses which the kings of Juda had given to the sun in the entrance of the house of the Lord, by the treasury of Nathan the king's eunuch, in the suburbs; and he burned the chariot of the sun with fire.

pob.text: As for the altars on the roof of the upper chamber of Ahaz[a], which the kings of Judah had made, and the altars that Manasseh had made in the two courts of the house of Yahweh, the king tore them down, smashed them there[b], and threw their dust into the Kidron Valley.

spob.text: The king tore down the altars that the kings of Judah had built on the roof of Ahaz’s upper room. He also tore down the altars Manasseh had built in the two courtyards of Yahweh’s temple. He smashed them there and threw their dust into the Kidron Valley.

public_domain_references.bsb: He pulled down the altars that the kings of Judah had set up on the roof near the upper chamber of Ahaz, and the altars that Manasseh had set up in the two courtyards of the house of the LORD. The king pulverized them there and threw their dust into the Kidron Valley.
public_domain_references.web: The king broke down the altars that were on the roof of the upper room of Ahaz, which the kings of Judah had made, and the altars which Manasseh had made in the two courts of Yahweh’s house, and beat them down from there, and cast their dust into the brook Kidron.
public_domain_references.asv: And the altars that were on the roof of the upper chamber of Ahaz, which the kings of Judah had made, and the altars which Manasseh had made in the two courts of the house of Jehovah, did the king break down, and beat [them] down from thence, and cast the dust of them into the brook Kidron.
public_domain_references.kjv: And the altars that [were] on the top of the upper chamber of Ahaz, which the kings of Judah had made, and the altars which Manasseh had made in the two courts of the house of the LORD, did the king beat down, and brake [them] down from thence, and cast the dust of them into the brook Kidron.
public_domain_references.brenton: And the altars that were on the roof of the upper chamber of Achaz, which the kings of Juda had made, and the altars which Manasses had made in the two courts of the house of the Lord, did the king pull down and forcibly remove from thence, and cast their dust into the brook of Kedron.

pob.text: And the king defiled the high places that were before Jerusalem[a], which were to the right of the Mount of Destruction, which Solomon king of Israel had built for Ashtoreth, the abomination of the Sidonians, and for Chemosh, the abomination of Moab, and for Milcom[c][b], the abomination of the Ammonites.

spob.text: The king made the high-place shrines in front of Jerusalem unfit for worship. They stood on the right side of the Mount of Destruction.[a] Solomon king of Israel had built them for Ashtoreth, the abomination of the Sidonians; Chemosh, the abomination of Moab; and Milcom,[b] the abomination of the Ammonites.

public_domain_references.bsb: The king also desecrated the high places east of Jerusalem, to the south of the Mount of Corruption, which King Solomon of Israel had built for Ashtoreth the abomination of the Sidonians, for Chemosh the abomination of the Moabites, and for Milcom the abomination of the Ammonites.
public_domain_references.web: The king defiled the high places that were before Jerusalem, which were on the right hand of the mountain of corruption, which Solomon the king of Israel had built for Ashtoreth the abomination of the Sidonians, and for Chemosh the abomination of Moab, and for Milcom the abomination of the children of Ammon.
public_domain_references.asv: And the high places that were before Jerusalem, which were on the right hand of the mount of corruption, which Solomon the king of Israel had builded for Ashtoreth the abomination of the Sidonians, and for Chemosh the abomination of Moab, and for Milcom the abomination of the children of Ammon, did the king defile.
public_domain_references.kjv: And the high places that [were] before Jerusalem, which [were] on the right hand of the mount of corruption, which Solomon the king of Israel had builded for Ashtoreth the abomination of the Zidonians, and for Chemosh the abomination of the Moabites, and for Milcom the abomination of the children of Ammon, did the king defile.
public_domain_references.brenton: And the king defiled the house that was before Jerusalem, on the right hand of the mount of Mosthath, which Solomon king of Israel built to Astarte the abomination of the Sidonians, and to Chamos the abomination of Moab, and to Moloch the abomination of the children of Ammon.

pob.text: He shattered the pillars[a], cut down the Asherim, and filled their places with human bones.

spob.text: He smashed the pillars and cut down the objects connected with Asherah worship.[a] Then he filled those sites with human bones.

public_domain_references.bsb: He smashed the sacred pillars to pieces, cut down the Asherah poles, and covered the sites with human bones.
public_domain_references.web: He broke in pieces the pillars, cut down the Asherah poles, and filled their places with men’s bones.
public_domain_references.asv: And he brake in pieces the pillars, and cut down the Asherim, and filled their places with the bones of men.
public_domain_references.kjv: And he brake in pieces the images, and cut down the groves, and filled their places with the bones of men.
public_domain_references.brenton: And he broke in pieces the pillars, and utterly destroyed the groves, and filled their places with the bones of men.

pob.text: Also the altar that was at Bethel—the high place that Jeroboam son of Nebat[a], who caused Israel to sin, had made—even that altar and the high place he tore down. He burned the high place, crushed it to dust, and burned the Asherah.

spob.text: He also tore down the altar and the high place of worship at Bethel. Jeroboam son of Nebat had made them and had caused Israel to sin. He burned the high place and crushed it to dust. He also burned the Asherah.[a]

public_domain_references.bsb: He even pulled down the altar at Bethel, the high place set up by Jeroboam son of Nebat, who had caused Israel to sin. Then he burned the high place, ground it to powder, and burned the Asherah pole.
public_domain_references.web: Moreover the altar that was at Bethel and the high place which Jeroboam the son of Nebat, who made Israel to sin, had made, even that altar and the high place he broke down; and he burned the high place and beat it to dust, and burned the Asherah.
public_domain_references.asv: Moreover the altar that was at Beth-el, and the high place which Jeroboam the son of Nebat, who made Israel to sin, had made, even that altar and the high place he brake down; and he burned the high place and beat it to dust, and burned the Asherah.
public_domain_references.kjv: ¶ Moreover the altar that [was] at Beth-el, [and] the high place which Jeroboam the son of Nebat, who made Israel to sin, had made, both that altar and the high place he brake down, and burned the high place, [and] stamped [it] small to powder, and burned the grove.
public_domain_references.brenton: Also the high altar in Bæthel, which Jeroboam the son of Nabat, who made Israel to sin, had made, even that high altar he tore down, and broke in pieces the stones of it, and reduced it to powder, and burnt the grove.

pob.text: Then Josiah turned and saw the tombs that were there on the mountain[a], and he sent and took the bones from the tombs and burned them on the altar and defiled it, according to the word of Yahweh that the man of God proclaimed[b], who proclaimed these things.

spob.text: Then Josiah turned and saw the tombs on the mountain.[a] He had the bones removed from the tombs and burned them on the altar, defiling it. This happened just as Yahweh had said through the man of God, who had publicly proclaimed that these things would happen.

public_domain_references.bsb: And as Josiah turned, he saw the tombs there on the hillside, and he sent someone to take the bones out of the tombs, and he burned them on the altar to defile it, according to the word of the LORD proclaimed by the man of God who had foretold these things.
public_domain_references.web: As Josiah turned himself, he spied the tombs that were there in the mountain; and he sent, and took the bones out of the tombs, and burned them on the altar, and defiled it, according to Yahweh’s word which the man of God proclaimed, who proclaimed these things.
public_domain_references.asv: And as Josiah turned himself, he spied the sepulchres that were there in the mount; and he sent, and took the bones out of the sepulchres, and burned them upon the altar, and defiled it, according to the word of Jehovah which the man of God proclaimed, who proclaimed these things.
public_domain_references.kjv: And as Josiah turned himself, he spied the sepulchres that [were] there in the mount, and sent, and took the bones out of the sepulchres, and burned [them] upon the altar, and polluted it, according to the word of the LORD which the man of God proclaimed, who proclaimed these words.
public_domain_references.brenton: And Josias turned aside, and saw the tombs that were there in the city, and sent, and took the bones out of the tombs, and burnt them on the altar, and defiled it, according to the word of the Lord which the man of God spoke, when Jeroboam stood by the altar at the feast: and he turned and raised his eyes to the tomb of the man of God that spoke these words.

pob.text: Then he said[a], “What is this monument that I see?” And the men of the city said to him[b], “It is the tomb of the man of God who came from Judah and proclaimed these things that you have done against the altar at Bethel.”

spob.text: Then he asked, “What is this monument I see?” The men of the city answered, “It marks the tomb of the man of God who came from Judah. He proclaimed what you have now done against the altar at Bethel.”

pob.text: Surely this came upon Judah at the command of Yahweh[a], to remove them from before his face because of the sins of Manasseh, according to all that he had done.
